newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka Banka's hotel group launches promotion.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka Banka's hotel group launches promotion.

text.p: Zagrebacka Banka's hotel management company Croatian Hotels & Resorts (CHR) launched a campaign on Wednesday to promote its hotels along the picturesque Adriatic coast.
"Our main goal is to convert the inherited tourist assets to meet international marketing standards," managing director Miro Dragicevic told Reuters.
Croatian Hotels & Resorts, which is mostly owned by the country's leading bank, was founded a year ago and manages some 40 hotels along the Adriatic.
The bulk of its business is in the ancient towns of Umag and Rovinj where it runs the two main holiday complexes owned by Zagrebacka Banka.
CHR's staff numbers leisure experts from Miami-based Barrington Group and Horwath & Horvath Consulting from Vienna.
Modern booking methods including a global distribution system which allows CHR to connect with 400,000 tourist agencies should help expand the market, the company said.
"We are not obsessed with the mere quantity of guests. Our main idea is to secure lasting profit for the hotel owners," said Dragicevic.
The campaign includes discounts and special sports and cultural packages for off-season dates.
Tourism is Croatia's main foreign currency earner, pulling in nearly 10 percent of the country's gross domestic product. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb newsroom + 385 1 455 7075
